Whenever I try to use the string_diagram command, I get this error in the VSCode infoview: Error rendering HTML: require is not defined. Do I miss something?

import Mathlib

open CategoryTheory

#string_diagram MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange
In the meantime, you can avoid the error by reverting to v4.28.0.
Thank you very much. The issue is that I need a recent version of Mathlib. I guess one workaround is to modifiy lake-manifest.json to get a more recent version of ProofWidgets?

I guess one workaround is to modifiy lake-manifest.json to get a more recent version of ProofWidgets?

Yes, that should work. You can change the revision required in lakefile.lean to main and then run lake update proofwidgets to update the lake-manifest.json.
Why aren't we just making a new release of ProofWidgets and bumping Mathlib to it?
